attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "The UserDisplayName tag helper drops its explicit Title binding while several core views (AuditTrail, Contents, Dashboard, Indexing, UrlRewriting) still pass a title attribute expecting Model.Title to populate the tooltip, so this shared, widely-reused admin shape risks silently losing tooltip text and any third-party module relying on the same tag helper's previous Title/DisplayType properties could break."}
